player_prompt.intro:
Wena uyisityebi {player_id} esijabulisa igemu lePig Dice.

Mazwi:
- Kulesitokisi sakho, uyakwazi '[roll]' noma '[hold]'
- Gijimisa 2-6: Yonkeza kwenkosazana yakho yesitokisi
- Gijimisa 1: Khula kwenkosazana yakho yesitokisi futhi isitokisi sishaye
- Thola: Yonkeza kwenkosazana yakho yesitokisi kwenkosazana yakho futhi isitokisi sishaye
- Owaye owaphambili ku〕{winning_score} iphoyinti ushaye

Kusasa kulesitokisi lakho, uyakwazi kubona amasikoro anamuhla kwenkosazana yakho yesitokisi.
Yiphendula ngokuthi '[roll]' ukuhamba idayi noma '[hold]' ukubamba iphoyinti zakho.
